# rwx_user (Data Source)

Looks up an existing active user in the authenticated organization by email or stable RWX user ID. Requires `org:access` with a personal or service-account access token. Known selectors resolve during planning; missing or unauthorized lookups fail the plan. This data source does not create or invite users or change memberships.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rwx_user" "by_email" {
  email = "engineer@example.com"
}

data "rwx_user" "by_id" {
  id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) The user's email. Lookup uses case-insensitive exact equality, without trimming, aliases, or fuzzy matching. Configure exactly one of `id` or `email`. Configured email casing is preserved; ID lookups return the stored email.
- `id` (String) The stable RWX user ID, not the identity ID. Configure exactly one of `id` or `email`.

### Read-Only

- `identity_id` (String) The user's RWX identity ID. This is distinct from the stable user `id`.
